purpose: Define explicit handshake/version compatibility metadata, including any currently required MD5 handshake field, without treating a compatibility digest as cryptographic identity or authorization.

topics.name: Transport Handshake Compatibility
topics.purpose: Define explicit handshake/version compatibility metadata, including any currently required MD5 handshake field, without treating a compatibility digest as cryptographic identity or authorization.

semantics.md5_rule: Where the current compatibility profile requires MD5, MD5 is treated only as compatibility/integrity metadata for that handshake field.
semantics.security_rule: MD5 is not treated as a modern identity proof, authorization proof or semantic identifier.
semantics.negotiation_rule: Unsupported mandatory profile/version fails before payload exchange.
semantics.upgrade_rule: Handshake fields/algorithms may be superseded only by an explicit compatible/new profile contract.
semantics.trace_rule: Handshake result retains negotiated profile/version and peer binding provenance.

invariants.rule: Transport session, cryptographic material, signaling metadata and semantic identity remain separate; secure transport never implies application authorization.

hard_gates.condition: MD5 digest treated as semantic identity
MD5 handshake field treated as sole authorization proof
handshake algorithm silently changed without profile/version semantics

references.purpose: Handshake precedes governed peer transport use.
